scores.evidence: On mobile, the s1-lifecycle flowchart TD fits the 390 px width with readable Japanese labels (pages/mobile-jp-04.png). All tables (s3-table, s4-scopes, s5-checks, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) fit without sideways scrolling (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, pages/mobile-jp-25.png, pages/mobile-jp-26.png). metrics.json reports overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid or image errors, 0 unknown blocks and no textOnlyScreens.

Every screen has a heading, code, table or check, and the quiz cards break up the text well. The prerequisites line on mobile is a dense grey run of 6 items (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). On mobile, the ex-register step stacks many inline code chips (pages/mobile-jp-10.png). Desktop JP charsPerLine median is 42, a little above the 30–40 target.

The Japanese-only lesson shows Japanese throughout, with English terms in parentheses (フック（hook）, 標準入力（stdin）). Diagram labels are Japanese, contrast is good on code blocks and callouts, and no controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-21.png, pages/mobile-jp-30.png). No personal data on any screen opened.

niceToHave: On mobile, line 9 of s2-settings and lines 9 and 18 of practice-model-settings soft-wrap inside the word 'hooks' ('.claude/hoo' / 'ks/block-rm.sh'), in .artifacts/preview/claude-code/cc-08-hooks-mcp/pages/mobile-jp-09.png and pages/mobile-jp-23.png. The lines are still readable and have a copy button. If you want cleaner wraps, use a shorter script folder or name (for example .claude/hooks/no-rm.sh) so the line breaks at a slash.

practice-model-intro: on mobile the long path chip '"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh' wraps inside 'prot|ect-files.sh' (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). It could be shown as a one-line code block instead of an inline chip, or the sentence could point to line 18 of the settings block below.

practice-b-model and practice-b-model-b come straight after the practice-b-quiz options, so the learner can see the model write-up before answering (pages/mobile-jp-25.png, pages/desktop-jp-18.png). The two tables also use different column widths on desktop, which makes A and B harder to compare. Consider one 3-column table (確かめること / A / B) placed after the quiz, or behind a reveal if the reader supports one.
Lesson prerequisites: the 6 prerequisites appear as one dense grey run-on line under the title (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). Shorten them (for example list only 第2回・第6回・第7回 and 'jqが入っている').
reader: on mobile the code-block header truncates the filename '.claude/hooks/protect-files…' with an ellipsis (pages/mobile-jp-22.png).
reader: soft-wrapped code lines continue at the code's left edge with no visible hanging indent (pages/mobile-jp-06.png line 9, pages/desktop-jp-07.png line 9).
reader: on mobile the flashcard hint says 'クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる', which is keyboard/mouse wording on a touch screen (pages/mobile-jp-32.png).
reader: desktop JP charsPerLine median is 42 (max 53), above the 30–40 target at a 680 px measure. The mobile full-length PNG is truncated, and failed /api/ requests (500) are environment noise.
summary: No must-fix items. All hard checks in metrics.json are clean, and the flowchart, tables, quizzes and code blocks are readable at 390 px and on desktop, with no personal data on any screen. The biggest optional improvements: hide or move the A/B model write-up tables below the practice-b-quiz, and avoid mid-word wraps in the long $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR hook paths on mobile.
